ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark/black) distribution across approximately 85% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters localized at the distal tips of both lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity (white) mottling localized at the distal regions of both the left and right lobes. The right lobe distal tip contains a larger contiguous region of high-intensity pixels compared to the left tip. The central and proximal regions are composed of uniform low-intensity black pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated pixel-based angle of 65 degrees and a moderate depth-to-width ratio relative to the fluke centerline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration pattern with varying pixel amplitudes (1-5 pixels). High-frequency, low-amplitude peaks are concentrated on the outer third of both trailing edges, transitioning to a smoother, lower-frequency topography toward the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a broadly concave curve from the median notch extending toward the tips, where the outer margin transitions to a convex curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, circular pixel groups observed on the distal margins of both lobes, particularly visible as raised bumps on the right tip contour.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct, vertical high-intensity (white) linear disruption is visible on the outer portion of the right lobe, oriented perpendicular to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive high-intensity scarring and mottling concentrated on the distal tips; visible irregular protrusions on the edge-contour of the right tip consistent with external parasitic colonization or calcified trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, high-contrast vertical white streak located approximately 15% inwards from the right fluke tip.
